description: An ancient, dark, and mysterious force organized as mercantile houses. Governed by game-theoretic cooperation, cold optimality, and statistical mechanics. Anti-life whose ethos is cosmic heat death, transporting themselves across deep time in glass stasis coffins. Pure technology, zero magic.
